seg.notes: Basis: Q4 earnings release Table D twelve-month column (cross-checked to 10-K segment note). Segments Aggregates, Concrete, Asphalt mix, Cement (Cement includes calcium products; calc_* null). agg_tons = total incl. internal tons. agg_price = freight-adjusted ASP incl. internal sales. Intersegment '-' shown as 0.0. seg_sales_total / interseg_total computed as sums of published segment lines. Total revenues = net sales + delivery revenues. cem_tons/cem_price are extra fields. From FY2012 the 'Other' DDA line includes DDA of temporarily idled assets excluded from segment gross profit (prior years recast). Aggregates customer tons 130.5m + internal 10.4m.

adj_items.other_label: Exchange offer costs (Martin Marietta unsolicited exchange offer, Dec-2011 to 2012)

ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation starts from net earnings, adds income taxes (continuing ops), interest expense net, and REMOVES (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (shown in ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added), then adds DDA&A. Hence ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops; the check passes once that line is included. Adjusted EBITDA (FY2012 release) = EBITDA excluding recovery from legal settlement (none in 2012), gain on sale of real estate and businesses (-65.1; note IS gain line is 68.5 - only real estate/business gains are adjusted), restructuring charges (+9.6) and exchange offer costs (+43.4, defense against Martin Marietta's hostile exchange offer, withdrawn 2012). Release says cash gross profit per ton increased 5% but no $ value -> null. No adjusted EPS published. VPP: Dec-2012 sale of future production (volumetric production payment) net proceeds $73.6m recorded as deferred revenue.
